summary.en: Trump arrived in Manila for an Asia trip, meeting Philippine leaders and discussing defence and economic deals, while the Philippines and India announced expanded maritime security cooperation. The Philippine Coast Guard reported 19 Chinese vessels operating around Ayungin Shoal and nearby features from Nov. 9 to 16, prompting Tarriela to criticize China’s actions. Australia and the Philippines signed a new defence cooperation arrangement, and ASEAN leaders met but a South China Sea code of conduct remains unlikely. The UCDP recorded 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Trump ankom Manila på en Asiatur, møtte filippinske ledere og diskuterte forsvars- og økonomiavtaler, mens Filippinene og India kunngjorde utvidet maritimt sikkerhetssamarbeid. Filippinernes kystvakt rapporterte 19 kinesiske fartøyer som opererte rundt Ayungin-revet og nærliggende områder fra 9. til 16. november, noe som fikk Tarriela til å kritisere Kinas handlinger. Australia og Filippinene signerte en ny forsvarssamarbeidsavtale, og ASEAN-lederne møttes, men en kode for oppførsel i Sør-Kina-havet virker fortsatt usannsynlig. UCDP registrerte 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.

President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. of the Philippines said on Wednesday that he had fried chicken delivered to President Trump during his overnight stay in Manila.

It wasn’t just any fried chicken. It came from Jollibee.
